title: IVC economy: more crops, crafts, ports and seals

boxes.title: Crops & farming: added
items: Also: **peas, lentil, chickpea**, horse gram, sesame, mustard; dates, melon, grapes, **henna**
Rig Veda: ==no cotton, rice, wheat== mentioned
Medieval: **maize** brought by the ==**Portuguese**==; **Uraiyur**: cotton trade

boxes.title: Animals & crafts: added
items: Also domesticated: **pig, fowl, cat, ass**; wild: deer, boar
Lothal: terracotta **horse figure** (reported); Surkotada horse bones c. **2000 BCE**
Beads of carnelian, steatite, **faience**, agate; also Kalibangan

boxes.title: More ports
head: Port
Note
rows: On **Dasht** river; cut off by **coastal uplift**

boxes.title: Seals, trade, weights: added
items: Square = animal + script; rectangular = script only; ==**button seal**: Lothal==
Harappan finds in **Oman, Bahrain, Iraq, Iran** (none in Egypt); **reserved slip ware** at Harappa
Weights accurate to **1-2%**; foot ~**37.6 cm**, cubit **51.8-53.6 cm**; scale divisions **1.75 cm**

boxes.title: Later metals & news
items: Rigvedic Aryans: gold, silver, copper; iron spread **1000-600 BC**
